race.comment: ZVEREV (4) drops down in standard from a couple of the maidens he has run in. On breeding he is desperate for ground so the added distance here can only be of benefit. Won't do any work early and should be strong late. MOLESWORTH (2) was beaten a fair way when first up. Given he got out to this sort of journey when last in work, it would no surprise to see good improvement. NIGHTOWL (3) should be ready now. Ran in a stronger race last time so go on his previous form angles. A firmer track would help. SENTALOA (10) has done little wrong but may be giving away a big start. Will have plenty of admirers now race fit. MEHSUN (1) was a little better at Bendigo. He will race on a quick back up and take on the older horses in this.
